title: [review] lib.rs: Division by zero panic
description: sfn_from_unix_time divides by superframe_duration_us. If caller passes 0, this causes a panic. The function should either return 0, saturate, or return Result<u32, Error> when superframe_duration_us is 0.
close_reason: Fixed: Added zero-check for superframe_duration_us at function entry, returns 0 to avoid division by zero panic. Added test coverage.
